generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The new test method `testUnblockWithNewDestinationIndex` covers an important scenario where the destination index changes while the transform is blocked. However, it does not verify if the transform actually starts indexing to the new destination after unblocking.

The method `changesDestIndex` in `TransformConfigUpdate` checks if the destination index has changed by comparing the current and updated indices using `isNullOrEqual`. This is correct but could be simplified by directly using `Objects.equals`, which handles nulls internally.

In `testDestinationIndexBlocked`, the assertion inside `assertBusy` was moved to a single line without changing functionality. This is fine but could be improved by adding comments or breaking it into multiple lines for better readability.

The refactoring in `randomTransformConfigWithoutHeaders` to use a helper method is beneficial for code reuse. However, it introduces a dependency on the order of parameters, which might lead to errors if not used carefully.

In `checkAndResetDestinationIndexBlock`, the logic to reset the waiting state when the destination index changes is clear. However, it does not handle cases where the indexer might be null or the current index cannot be retrieved. The method assumes that `getIndexer().getConfig()` will always return a non-null configuration, which may not be true in all scenarios.

The test methods added for `changesDestIndex` and `checkAndResetDestinationIndexBlock` cover various scenarios including null updates, equal indices, new indices, and different states of the transform task. This is good coverage but could include more edge cases such as handling null or invalid configurations.

review_comment: I don't know the code base well but is it possible for the nested objects to be null too? Or only the result of `getIndexer()`?

Only the result of `getIndexer()`:
- indexer verifies that [config](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/transform/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/transform/transforms/TransformIndexer.java#L160) is non null
- [destination](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/core/transform/transforms/TransformConfig.java#L230) does too
- [index](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/core/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/core/transform/transforms/DestConfig.java#L60) does too
